output.title: When a call summary appears in the member portal
output.draft_text:
Question: When will the call summary show in the member portal?

Answer (advocate wording): "A summary of today's call will appear in your member portal within two business days." (Source: approved unit U-KNOWN-FACT. Advocates may say this in their own words.)

Where to find it: The summary will be in [portal section or menu path where call summaries appear].

If it doesn't appear: If the summary is not in the portal after two business days, [next step for the member, such as calling back or using a portal contact option].

Scope: This timeframe applies to [call types or lines covered, such as all pharmacy calls or only certain call types].
